# @wonderful/types

TypeScript type definitions for Wonderful runtime development.

## Installation

```bash
pnpm install @wonderful/types
```

## Usage

Import and use the context types in your tool's `index.ts`:

```typescript
import type { Context } from '@wonderful/types';

interface WonderfulParams {
  name: string;
  age: number;
}

async function main(context: Context, params: WonderfulParams): any {
  // Access context functions
  context.kv.set('lastUser', params.name);
  context.agent.announce(`Hello ${params.name}!`);

  return {
    success: true
  };
}
```

## Development

```bash
# Install dependencies
pnpm install

# Build the package
pnpm build

# Clean build artifacts
pnpm clean
